Provides the ability to manage Bring-Your-Own-IP prefixes (BYOIP) which are used with or without Magic Transit.\n12. \n13. ## Example Usage\n14. \n15. ```hcl\n16. resource \"cloudflare_byo_ip_prefix\" \"example\" {\n17.     prefix_id = \"d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e\"\n18.     description = \"Example IP Prefix\"\n19.     advertisement = \"on\"\n20. }\n21. ```\n22. \n23. ## Argument Reference\n24. \n25.
